name: pstack
description: pstack: architect → poteto-mode → interrogate (needs the pstack skills; they start more agents of their own)

steps.name: design
prompt: Run the skill's Ground and Sketch phases, then stop before Implement: the implementer fills the sketch in. Commit the sketch (the caller's usage, types, signatures and module shape, with not-implemented bodies) as one commit, and write its rationale to {{run}}/design.md.

steps.name: implement
steps.label: implementation
prompt: Take the playbook that fits (Feature, or Bug fix for a defect). The architect has done its how and architect steps: start from {{run}}/design.md and the sketch it committed, and fill the sketch in. Skip Opening a PR: the interrogator takes the change next. Verify it on the real surface, change nothing in {{run}}/, and commit in small ordered commits.
again: Fix each at its root cause, or say why it breaks nothing. Verify again, and commit.

steps.name: review
steps.label: interrogation
prompt: The scope is git diff {{base}}, uncommitted work included; the intent is the task and {{run}}/design.md. Change no file in this worktree: repros stay in your adversaries' worktrees or a temporary directory. Any verified finding means CHANGES.
again: The implementer has worked through your findings. Interrogate git diff {{base}} again: are they fixed, and does anything new break? Any verified finding means CHANGES.
